# Accomplishments reference

Progress counts from the moment a club is created (no back pay). Collect finished challenges with **Redeem**. Packs and cards are untradeable.

## Goals

| Challenge | Goal | Reward |
|---|---|---|
| Goalscorer 10 | Score 10 goals. | 2,500 coins |
| Goalscorer 50 | Score 50 goals. | 10,000 coins + Premium Gold pack |
| Goalscorer 100 | Score 100 goals. | 15,000 coins + Rare Players pack |
| Goalscorer 250 | Score 250 goals. | 25,000 coins + Jumbo Premium Gold pack |
| Goalscorer 500 | Score 500 goals. | 40,000 coins + Mega pack |
| Goalscorer 1000 | Score 1000 goals. | 75,000 coins + Ultimate pack |
